annotations.text:
Second pass — the screens the decisions change.

This empty Circle is the screen the observed user failed on. Today it has no actions at all: an icon, "No active groups", and one dim sentence. Code first, because these groups form in person.

Circle is people only now.

The filter chips stay — they qualify people. The "Your groups" section below the list is gone; it was the second rendering of the same set, and the doorway into a whole parallel plan surface.

The Reflections tweak above the frame shows the row in both its states.

One card shape, solo or shared.

Same anatomy, same primary action, same pace control. The shared card adds members; nothing else differs — which is what the first spec decided and the build did not do.

"Open schedule" replaces "Read together": the card already is reading together.

The pencil tooltipped "Edit plan" became this.

Owner-only, consequence stated before the options, and an explicit way out to Adjust pace for the reader who only needs their own dates moved.
